sourceSentences.text: The Marvelous Land of Oz was published in 1904 by L. Frank Baum.

This ebook was produced for Standard Ebooks by Maxwell Aires, and is based on a transcription produced in 1993 by Distributed Proofreaders for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from the HathiTrust Digital Library.
